result.sourceOracle: Pure deterministic source module, independent of SQL and reader responses
result.coverage: Full searchable corpus; fixed 256-page remote body hotset and 8 media objects; not full content/cold access coverage
result.rankingScope: Exact total; unique eligible Top10; exact metadata/prefix snippet; BM25 order equivalence not asserted

generator.note: Outside reader/MinIO budgets; process maxRSS is a cumulative process peak, not a per-phase peak

limits: Short synthetic windows, not production SLO
Web search alternates rare and published-marker queries, then reads the actual first returned hit; not broad Web query coverage
SSR endpoint verified; no browser hydration, rendering or human UX claim
One shared reader budget; separate larger MinIO budget does not prove MinIO is not a bottleneck
Worker deadline includes admission queue and execution; timeout is not proof of SQL execution taking four seconds
Highest qualified consumer rate is an observed lower bound, not maximum system capacity
All 409 remain unfulfilled user journeys requiring research/retry

updateObservation.source: Derived from durable download-end event and raw terminal lane rows; failed update response has no success receipt. Original result overlap=0 cannot establish absence of overlap.

build.scope: Builder only. Compact source oracle; full searchable rows, bounded hot remote-content working set. Not a reader footprint.

publish.trust: local pinned receipt; not production release discovery/IAM
